argus-world.介绍: Tax-token launchpad on Arc. Each launch mints its whole supply into a single-sided Uniswap v4 position held by a locker with no withdrawal path, so there is no bonding curve and no migration — the token trades in a real v4 pool from block one, and a per-launch hook charges a buy/sell tax on every swap.

口径.Fees: The tax ArgusPad's per-launch hook charges on every buy and sell, the trading fee each launch's pool charges (on Portals 3-7 the 1% pool fee earned by the permanently locked launch position; on Portal 8 a 1% base fee the hook charges in the quote asset in its place), and the extra tax charged on buys in a launch's first seconds. Counted in the asset the fee is charged in, at the moment it is charged, so the protocol's later sale of the launched tokens it was paid is not counted a second time. Fees charged in the launched token itself (Portals 3-7 only; Portal 8 takes every fee in the quote asset) are reported in that token's own units and are priced only if DefiLlama has a price for it; it has none for these tokens today, because a launched token's only market is the pool ArgusPad seeded, and pricing it there overstates by about 40% against what ArgusPad's own sales of them actually realise.
口径.ProtocolRevenue: The share of fees reaching the ArgusPad treasury at the rate each launch fixes at creation - 10% of every fee on Portals 3-7 and 30% on Portal 8 - plus the whole of the early-buy snipe tax, which is paid straight to the treasury.
口径.Revenue: The share of fees reaching the ArgusPad treasury at the rate each launch fixes at creation - 10% of every fee on Portals 3-7 and 30% on Portal 8 - plus the whole of the early-buy snipe tax, which is paid straight to the treasury.
口径.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the fees, which leave the protocol divided at the weights each launch fixed at creation: the token creator's share, the dividends paid to holders of that launched token, the share added back into the launch's permanently locked liquidity, the share used to buy and burn the launched token, and on Portal 8 the share used to buy the launched token and lock it permanently.

口径.ProtocolRevenue: v1: 25% of the curve trade fee net of referrer rewards, plus WETH sent to the factory owner at graduation. v1.2: residual share of the curve trade fee (50% at the time of writing, net of referrer rewards), its share of graduation payouts (0% at the time of writing), the protocol owner's share of the V4 hook fee (protocolFeeRatio, owner-tunable) and the protocol's share of collected seed-position LP fees.
口径.Revenue: Protocol revenue across both deployments: on v1, the protocol's 25% of the bonding-curve trade fee net of referrer rewards plus the factory owner's graduation share; on v1.2, the residual share of the trade fee after referrer and creator cuts (creator share owner-tunable via creatorShareBps), the protocol's graduation share, the protocol owner's share of the hook fee on every V4 swap, and the protocol's share of collected seed-position LP fees. Frontier has no protocol token, so there is no holders revenue and Revenue equals ProtocolRevenue.
口径.SupplySideRevenue: v1: the creator's 75% of every curve trade fee, referrer rewards, and the 5% graduation fee to the token creator. v1.2: the creator's share of every curve trade fee (50% at the time of writing), referrer rewards, the 5% graduation fee to the creator, the graduation refund to the caller (0% at the time of writing), and the after-protocol remainder of the V4 hook fee and of collected seed-position LP fees, split between the coin's staking vault and its fee recipient (the creator).

sapling.介绍: Sapling is the first zcash-native launchpad & terminal. Launch, trade and cash out coins straight from a Zcash wallet, shielded. Coins launch on Raydium LaunchLab, paired with ZEC, hSOL or tokenized stocks. Sapling's 2% of every trade is split on chain: 0.5% buys and burns $SAPLING, 0.5% deepens $SAPLING/ZEC liquidity, 0.5% buys back and burns the top Sapling coins, and 0.5% goes to the treasury. Deployers can add up to 3% more for their holders, paid in ZEC

口径.Fees: The 2% fee on every buy and sell of a coin launched on Sapling, the flat fee paid to plant a coin, and Sapling's fee on buys, plantings and sales made from a Zcash account. On Robinhood Chain: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee on every buy and sell of a coin planted through Sapling, both paid to Sapling's splitter, plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee, paid in USDG to the treasury. On Raydium LaunchLab (from 2026-10-28): any platform fee claimed from the curve and Sapling's fees from the coin's graduated pool; excludes the coin's transfer tax (Sapling's 2.00% plus the deployer's tax of none to 3%), which is taken on every transfer of the coin, wallet to wallet included.
口径.HoldersRevenue: 50% of the 2% coin trading fee: 25% buys and burns $SAPLING, and 25% goes to the $SAPLING/ZEC pool on PumpSwap, where about half of it buys $SAPLING, both sides are deposited and the LP tokens are burned, so no one, Sapling included, can withdraw it. On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee. For LaunchLab coins, half of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees: $SAPLING buyback and burn, and the protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool, whose position is locked for good.
口径.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury's share: 10% of the 2% coin trading fee, plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee. For LaunchLab coins, the treasury's and the flywheel's quarters of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees. On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee.
口径.Revenue: The part of the 2% coin trading fee Sapling keeps (10% treasury, 25% $SAPLING buyback and burn, 25% $SAPLING/ZEC liquidity), plus the planting fee and the Zcash account fee. For LaunchLab coins, all of the curve platform fee and the graduated pool's fees (a quarter each to the treasury, the flywheel, $SAPLING buyback and burn, and the protocol-owned $SAPLING/ZEC pool). On Robinhood Chain the shares apply to what reaches Sapling's splitter: the 2% creator tax plus the creator's 70% of Pons's 1% fee.
口径.SupplySideRevenue: 40% of the 2% coin trading fee, paid to each coin's deployer, a wallet they choose, or the holders of that coin as holder rewards (on Robinhood Chain, 40% of what reaches Sapling's splitter). LaunchLab coins pay their deployers from the coin's transfer tax, which is not counted.

stockereum.介绍: Token launchpad on Ethereum where every token launches into a locked Uniswap v4 pool paired with tokenized stocks, memecoins, stablecoins or ETH

口径.Fees: The fee the Stockereum hook charges on every swap, in the quote currency, from the hook's Trade event: 1% on v2 launches, 1%, 2% or 3% (chosen by the creator) on v3 launches, plus the anti-snipe rate in the first moments after a launch.
口径.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's share of the swap fee.
口径.Revenue: The platform's share of the swap fee: half of the normal 1% on v2, 0.5% of the trade on 1% v3 launches and 1% of the trade on 2% and 3% v3 launches, plus any anti-snipe excess.
口径.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the swap fee, paid to the launch's creator or, on launches with holder rewards enabled, to the launched token's holders.

stonkbrokers-safe-launch.介绍: Token launch platform using bonding curves and anti-snipe launch windows, with launch proceeds graduating into permanently locked DEX liquidity

口径.Fees: Safe Launch / Stonklauncher snipe tax on window buys and sells across all pad generations (16.5% creator / 16.5% protocol / 50% locked-LP or ICO Bonus / 17% StockBooster + Clock In Card referrers); the anti-snipe fair-launch snipe tax (time-decay tax on launch-curve buys, 90% StockBooster / 10% launch dev); and StonkCurvePool 1% trade fees (33/33/33 waterfall).
口径.ProtocolRevenue: 16.5% of the Safe Launch / Stonklauncher snipe tax → protocol accrual; 33.34% of bonding-curve trade fees → protocol.
口径.Revenue: The 16.5% protocol leg of the Safe Launch / Stonklauncher snipe tax and 33.34% of bonding-curve trade fees.
口径.SupplySideRevenue: Safe Launch tax legs to the launch creator (16.5%), StockBooster + Clock In Card referrers (17%), and the permanently locked LP reserve / ICO Bonus (50%); 90% of the anti-snipe launch tax → StockBooster dividends and 10% → launch dev; bonding-curve creator (33.33%) + StonkBrokers Directed Clock In / pot (33.33%).

stonkfun.介绍: A Solana launchpad to launch coins paired with anything.

口径.Fees: Trading fees StonkFun collects, measured when it claims them: the 1% platform fee on its Raydium LaunchLab bonding curves (every platform config whose fees it claims), the creator fee on the Raydium CPMM pools those launches graduate into, and the quote side of fees harvested from the permanently locked liquidity behind pre-LaunchLab launches. Raydium's own fee shares are excluded. Each token is valued with Dune trade prices at the hour it was received, ignoring trades priced more than 10x away from that day's median.
口径.HoldersRevenue: Quote assets spent buying STONK on Jupiter, identified on-chain as swaps that returned STONK to the operator wallet, at the net amount each swap spent.
口径.ProtocolRevenue: Fees StonkFun keeps after paying the creator share of standard launches and the flywheel share of reward launches, minus the quote assets spent buying STONK on Jupiter. From 2026-08-28, fees paid in STONK and fees from STONK's own pool are excluded. Buybacks spend income claimed on earlier days, so this is negative when a buyback is larger than the day's retained fees.
口径.Revenue: Fees less the creator share of standard launches and the flywheel share of reward launches, as paid out on-chain. From 2026-08-28, fees paid in STONK and fees from STONK's own pool are excluded: they cannot fund a STONK buyback.
口径.SupplySideRevenue: Creator and flywheel shares of fees, measured when they are paid out.
